home.heroSubtitle: A careful selection for home, family, the road, and your time.
home.statementBody: At RAVILO we look for products you will actually use. Simple, useful things, chosen for home, family, the car, and everyday life.
home.categoriesTitle: For the things that belong in every day.
home.categoriesSubtitle: From home to longer journeys, practical things for the moments that keep coming back.
home.picksSubtitle: Simple, useful products, chosen for the way we live.
home.popularSubtitle: Things that earn their place — from real orders, or from our selection.
home.popularNote: Our selection until there are enough orders.
home.shopByProblemSubtitle: Start from what you need to solve, not from a crowded shelf.
home.placesTitle: For the places and people that matter.
home.placesBody: At home, in the car, on a trip, or on an ordinary day — sometimes small things make everything a little simpler.
home.why1Body: We don’t add products just to have more. Each one should have a reason.
home.why2Body: We look for things you will actually use, not just add to a cart.
home.why3Body: Clear information, secure payment, and an experience without extra noise.
home.why4Body: If you have a question, write to us. We prefer a clear answer over a wall of forms.
home.newsletterHint: Updates and carefully chosen products. No extra noise.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Use this form for withdrawal, defects or exchanges. Photos help us decide faster. The order must be yours.
returns.policy1: You have 14 calendar days from delivery to withdraw, without giving a reason.
returns.policy2: Return the product complete and undamaged, with everything in the box. Hygiene seals, if any, must be intact.
returns.policy3: For defects, wrong items or shipping damage, upload clear photos (product, label, packaging).
returns.policy4: Refunds go back to the original payment method or your IBAN after we receive and check the parcel.

legal.aboutIntro: RAVILO started from a simple idea: we don’t need more products. We need better chosen ones.
legal.aboutP2: We look for useful things for home, family, the car, and everyday journeys. Products you understand quickly, use often, and that earn their place in your life.
legal.aboutP3: We don’t want to be the shop where you can find anything. We’d rather be the place where you find things chosen for a reason.
legal.aboutHow3: They balance usefulness, design, and price
legal.aboutHow4: They fit the way we live every day
legal.aboutFinalBody: RAVILO is about simple choices and good things, for the places and people that matter.
legal.aboutHtml: RAVILO started from a simple idea: we don’t need more products. We need better chosen ones.
legal.shippingHtml: We ship in Romania. Shipping is calculated at checkout, on the server, from active methods. Over the free-shipping threshold, delivery is 0.
legal.returnsHtml: You have 14 days to withdraw, under Romanian law. The product must be returned in proper condition. Full details are published from Admin → Pages.
legal.termsHtml: By using the RAVILO store you agree to the terms of sale, shipping and returns. The full legal text is edited from Admin → Pages.
legal.privacyHtml: We process the data needed for orders, accounts and legal duties. We do not sell data. You can request access, correction or deletion from Account → Privacy.
legal.cookiesHtml: We use necessary cookies to run the shop (cart, session, language and theme). Analytics and marketing only after consent. You can change your choice by deleting the consent cookie in your browser.
